(4) Tone includes 'ominous' but misses 'urgent' from reference (though tone is interpretive). (5) Camera tags miss 'wide_master.' (6) Color tags include 'monochrome' which is questionable given red illumination pulses. (7) The description of background as 'dark red gradient' and 'diagonal rain-like streaks' is reasonable for the diagonal lines. Overall, there are enough correct observations but the motion characterization errors, invented emotion tags, and missing key details (pulsing light, wide master) bring the score below the 0.8 threshold."}
